procedures.acceptance_condition: The hash matches the released commissioning tool; an unidentified tool does not write
procedures.action: Verify the tool identity: confirm the commissioning tool's content hash matches the released tool before any writing begins

procedures.acceptance_condition: A read after erase returns the erased value rather than the previous configuration's value
procedures.action: Erase the item's non-volatile memory and confirm the erase completed before writing
procedures.decision_point: Whether a partial erase may be recovered from or must scrap the item

procedures.acceptance_condition: The readback hash equals the released build's hash exactly
procedures.action: Write the application image and read it back, comparing the content hash with the released build
procedures.decision_point: Whether a hash mismatch may be rewritten once or must stop the item

procedures.acceptance_condition: The readback hash equals the released bootloader's hash exactly
procedures.action: Write the bootloader image and read it back on the same terms

procedures.acceptance_condition: Every written value equals the registry value for its parameter id, and every parameter the item reads is present
procedures.action: Write the safe-operating-area limit set, resolving every value from the canonical parameter registry rather than typing it at the station
procedures.decision_point: Whether a parameter may be written to a value outside its registered range, which this specification forbids without a change record

procedures.acceptance_condition: Every table entry is inside its stated tolerance against a calibrated reference
procedures.action: Write the sensor calibration tables and verify each entry against the reference measurement
procedures.decision_point: Whether an entry outside tolerance causes a resample or a scrap

procedures.acceptance_condition: The integrity check passes on the written image and would fail on any single flipped bit in the limit set or in a calibration table
procedures.action: Apply the integrity check over the whole non-volatile memory and record the check result
procedures.decision_point: Whether an item failing the integrity check may be retried or must be scrapped
